question_es: El mecanismo central del Transformer que permite que cada token atienda a todos los demás tokens de la secuencia se llama ___.
question_en: The core mechanism of the Transformer that allows each token to attend to all other tokens in the sequence is called ___.
explanation_es: El self-attention calcula la relevancia de cada token respecto a los demás usando matrices Query, Key y Value (Q, K, V). Esto permite capturar dependencias de largo alcance en operaciones paralelas.
explanation_en: Self-attention computes the relevance of each token to every other token using Query, Key, and Value matrices (Q, K, V), enabling long-range dependency capture through parallel operations.
source: Vaswani et al., 'Attention Is All You Need' (NeurIPS 2017), Section 3.2.1

question_es: El proceso de dividir un texto en unidades individuales (tokens) que un modelo de lenguaje puede procesar se llama ___.
question_en: The process of breaking down text into individual units (tokens) that a language model can understand and process is called ___.
explanation_es: La tokenización convierte texto en símbolos discretos. Los tipos incluyen tokenización a nivel de palabra, subpalabra (BPE, WordPiece) y carácter.
explanation_en: Tokenization converts text into discrete symbols. Common approaches include word-level, subword (BPE, WordPiece), and character-level tokenization.
source: Hugging Face Transformers Documentation, Section 'Tokenizers'

question_es: La técnica de prompt engineering donde se proporcionan uno o más ejemplos de patrones entrada-salida deseados antes de la consulta es llamada ___ learning.
question_en: The prompt engineering technique where you provide one or more examples of the desired input-output pattern before the request is called ___ learning.
explanation_es: El few-shot learning demuestra al modelo ejemplos de cómo completar una tarea antes de solicitar que la ejecute en nuevos datos, mejorando el desempeño.
explanation_en: Few-shot learning demonstrates to the model how to complete a task through examples before requesting execution on new data, improving performance.
source: OpenAI GPT API Documentation; Brown et al., 'Language Models are Few-Shot Learners' (NeurIPS 2020)

question_es: La técnica de prompting avanzado que instruye al modelo a resolver problemas paso a paso, revelando el razonamiento intermedio antes de la respuesta final, se llama razonamiento de ___.
question_en: The advanced prompting technique that instructs the model to work through problems step-by-step, revealing intermediate reasoning before the final answer, is called ___ reasoning.
explanation_es: Chain-of-thought elicita un razonamiento más preciso al pedirle al modelo que verbalize sus pasos intermedios, mejorando la resolución de problemas complejos.
explanation_en: Chain-of-thought elicits more accurate reasoning by asking the model to verbalize intermediate steps, improving complex problem-solving performance.
source: Wei et al., 'Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models' (NeurIPS 2022)

question_es: El parámetro ___ controla la aleatoriedad de las salidas del modelo, donde valores altos producen texto más diverso y valores bajos hacen la salida más determinista.
question_en: The ___ parameter controls the randomness of model outputs, where higher values produce more diverse text and lower values make outputs more deterministic.
explanation_es: Temperature escala la distribución de probabilidades sobre los tokens. Valores típicos: 0.1 (determinista), 0.7-1.0 (creativo), >1.0 (muy aleatorio).
explanation_en: Temperature scales the probability distribution over tokens. Typical ranges: 0.1 (deterministic), 0.7-1.0 (creative), >1.0 (highly random).
source: OpenAI API Documentation; Ackley et al., 'A Learning Algorithm for Boltzmann Machines' (1985)

question_es: La práctica de recuperar documentos relevantes de una base de conocimientos y usarlos para enriquecer prompts antes de la generación se llama generación aumentada por ___.
question_en: The practice of retrieving relevant documents from a knowledge base and using them to augment prompts before generation is called ___ augmented generation.
explanation_es: RAG combina recuperación de información con generación de lenguaje. Reduce alucinaciones al anclar respuestas en documentos reales.
explanation_en: RAG combines information retrieval with language generation, reducing hallucinations by grounding answers in retrieved documents.
source: Lewis et al., 'Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks' (NeurIPS 2020)

question_es: Los vectores numéricos densos que representan el significado semántico de texto y permiten búsquedas de similitud en bases de datos vectoriales se llaman ___.
question_en: Dense numerical vectors that represent the semantic meaning of text and enable similarity search in vector databases are called ___.
explanation_es: Los embeddings son representaciones continuas de texto en espacios de alta dimensionalidad. Modelos como BERT, GPT y sentence-transformers generan embeddings.
explanation_en: Embeddings are continuous representations of text in high-dimensional spaces. Models like BERT, GPT, and sentence-transformers generate embeddings.
source: Hinton et al., 'Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks' (2006); Devlin et al., 'BERT' (2019)

question_es: La métrica de similitud ___ mide el ángulo entre dos vectores de embedding, siendo computacionalmente eficiente y popular en bases de datos vectoriales.
question_en: The ___ similarity metric measures the angle between two embedding vectors, making it computationally efficient and popular in vector databases.
explanation_es: Similitud coseno = (A · B) / (||A|| ||B||). Rango [0, 1] normalizado. Ventaja: invariante a la escala, eficiente en altas dimensiones.
explanation_en: Cosine similarity = (A · B) / (||A|| ||B||). Range [0, 1] normalized. Advantage: scale-invariant, efficient in high dimensions.
source: Information Retrieval textbooks; Pinecone, Weaviate documentation

question_es: El proceso de dividir documentos grandes en fragmentos más pequeños y semánticamente coherentes para optimizar la precisión en sistemas RAG se llama ___.
question_en: The process of dividing large documents into smaller, semantically coherent pieces to optimize retrieval accuracy in RAG systems is called ___.
explanation_es: Chunking considera tamaño (tokens), solapamiento y límites semánticos. Chunks de 512-1024 tokens con solapamiento del 20% suelen funcionar bien.
explanation_en: Chunking considers size (tokens), overlap, and semantic boundaries. Chunks of 512-1024 tokens with 20% overlap typically work well.
source: LangChain Documentation; Harrison Chase et al., LangChain GitHub

question_es: En sistemas RAG, el componente ___ rescorifica documentos recuperados inicialmente para asegurar que los fragmentos más relevantes sean seleccionados para el modelo.
question_en: In RAG systems, the ___ component rescores initially retrieved documents to ensure the most relevant passages are selected for the language model.
explanation_es: Reranking mejora la calidad de la recuperación. Modelos como BGE-reranker y Cohere Rerank usan cross-encoders para puntuaciones más precisas.
explanation_en: Reranking improves retrieval quality. Models like BGE-reranker and Cohere Rerank use cross-encoders for more accurate scoring.
source: Cohere Reranker API; BGE (BAAI General Embedding) documentation; Nogueira et al., 'Cross-encoders' (2019)

question_es: Un sistema autónomo que percibe su entorno, toma decisiones mediante razonamiento y ejecuta acciones para lograr objetivos se llama ___.
question_en: An autonomous system that perceives its environment, makes decisions through reasoning, and executes actions to accomplish goals is called an ___.
explanation_es: Los agentes tienen ciclos de percepción-razonamiento-acción. Pueden usar herramientas, actualizar memoria y colaborar con otros agentes.
explanation_en: Agents have perception-reasoning-action cycles. They can use tools, update memory, and collaborate with other agents.
source: LangChain Agents; Yao et al., 'ReAct' (2023); Russell & Norvig, 'AI: A Modern Approach' (2020)

question_es: La capacidad de un modelo de lenguaje para invocar funciones externas, APIs o herramientas para realizar tareas más allá de la generación de texto se llama ___ calling.
question_en: The ability for a language model to invoke external functions, APIs, or tools to perform tasks beyond text generation is called ___ calling.
explanation_es: Function calling permite a LLMs decidir qué herramientas usar e invocarlas con parámetros. Implementado en OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.
explanation_en: Function calling allows LLMs to decide which tools to use and invoke them with parameters. Implemented by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.
source: OpenAI Function Calling API; Anthropic Tool Use; LangChain ToolUse

question_es: En frameworks de agentes como LangChain, la definición estructurada de parámetros, tipo de retorno y descripción de una herramienta se llama ___.
question_en: In agent frameworks like LangChain, the structured definition of a tool's parameters, return type, and description is called a tool ___.
explanation_es: El schema define: nombre, descripción, parámetros con tipos y restricciones. Usa JSON Schema. Permite validación y generación de prompts precisos.
explanation_en: Schema defines: name, description, parameters with types and constraints. Uses JSON Schema. Enables validation and precise prompt generation.
source: LangChain Tool Schema documentation; JSON Schema specification

question_es: El framework ___ combina razonamiento y acción del modelo de lenguaje, donde genera pensamientos, acciones y observaciones en un bucle iterativo.
question_en: The ___ framework combines language model reasoning and action, where the model generates thoughts, actions, and observations in an iterative loop.
explanation_es: ReAct alterna entre razonamiento verbal y acciones ejecutables. Mejora el desempeño en tareas complejas frente a solo razonamiento o solo actuación.
explanation_en: ReAct alternates between verbal reasoning and executable actions. Improves performance on complex tasks versus reasoning or acting alone.
source: Yao et al., 'ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models' (ICLR 2023)

question_es: El patrón donde múltiples agentes IA colaboran, cada uno con roles distintos y capacidades especializadas, trabajando hacia un objetivo compartido se llama sistemas ___.
question_en: The pattern where multiple AI agents collaborate, each with distinct roles and specialized capabilities, working toward a shared objective is called ___ systems.
explanation_es: Sistemas multi-agente coordinan mediante mensajería, blackboards o protocolos. Cada agente especializándose mejora escalabilidad y mantenibilidad.
explanation_en: Multi-agent systems coordinate via messaging, blackboards, or protocols. Agent specialization improves scalability and maintainability.
source: Park et al., 'Generative Agents' (UIST 2023); multi-agent orchestration frameworks

question_es: La práctica sistemática de rastrear diferentes versiones de datasets, checkpoints de modelos e hiperparámetros con metadatos para reproducibilidad se llama control de ___.
question_en: The systematic practice of tracking different versions of datasets, model checkpoints, and hyperparameters with metadata for reproducibility is called ___ control.
explanation_es: DVC (Data Version Control) y MLflow permiten versionar datos y modelos. Fundamental para reproducibilidad y experimentación rastreable.
explanation_en: DVC (Data Version Control) and MLflow enable versioning of data and models. Essential for reproducibility and traceable experimentation.
source: DVC Documentation; MLflow Tracking; Sculley et al., 'Hidden Technical Debt in ML Systems' (NIPS 2015)

question_es: Un workflow automatizado que orquesta preprocesamiento de datos, entrenamiento de modelo, validación y evaluación de manera reproducible se llama ___ pipeline.
question_en: An automated workflow that orchestrates data preprocessing, model training, validation, and evaluation in a reproducible manner is called a ___ pipeline.
explanation_es: Pipelines de ML usan Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow. Automatizan pasos, garantizan consistencia y habilitan integración continua para ML.
explanation_en: ML pipelines use Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow. They automate steps, ensure consistency, and enable continuous integration for ML.
source: Kubeflow documentation; MLflow Projects; Airflow; Sculley et al., 'Hidden Technical Debt in ML Systems' (2015)

question_es: El proceso de tomar un modelo entrenado del desarrollo y ponerlo disponible en producción para que usuarios finales lo consulten se llama ___ del modelo.
question_en: The process of taking a trained model from development and making it available in production for end-users to query is called model ___.
explanation_es: Deployment incluye containerización (Docker), orquestación (Kubernetes) y API serving. Debe considerar latencia, escalabilidad y tolerancia a fallos.
explanation_en: Deployment includes containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and API serving. Must consider latency, scalability, and fault tolerance.
source: MLflow Models; BentoML; KServe documentation; Model Serving best practices

question_es: La observación continua de métricas de desempeño del modelo desplegado para detectar degradación, drift de datos o drift conceptual a lo largo del tiempo se llama ___.
question_en: The continuous observation of deployed model performance metrics to detect degradation, data drift, or concept drift over time is called ___.
explanation_es: Monitoring usa herramientas como Evidently AI, WhyLabs. Detecta cambios en P(X) (data drift) y P(Y|X) (concept drift) automáticamente.
explanation_en: Monitoring uses tools like Evidently AI, WhyLabs. Detects changes in P(X) (data drift) and P(Y|X) (concept drift) automatically.
source: Evidently AI documentation; WhyLabs; Polyzotis et al., 'Data Validation' (VLDB 2019)

question_es: Los errores sistemáticos en predicciones del modelo que desventajan desproporcionadamente a ciertos grupos demográficos se llaman ___.
question_en: Systematic errors in model predictions that disproportionately disadvantage certain demographic groups are referred to as model ___.
explanation_es: Tipos: histórico (datos sesgados), representacional (entrenamiento), de medición. Mitigan auditorías, datasets balanceados y fairness constraints.
explanation_en: Types: historical (biased data), representational (training), measurement. Mitigated by audits, balanced datasets, and fairness constraints.
source: Barocas et al., 'Fairness and Machine Learning' (fairmlbook.org); Buolamwini & Buolamwini, 'Gender Shades' (2018)

question_es: El framework de privacidad ___ añade ruido calibrado al entrenamiento o salidas del modelo para prevenir ataques de reconstrucción manteniendo utilidad.
question_en: The ___ privacy framework adds calibrated noise to model training or outputs to prevent reconstruction attacks while maintaining utility.
explanation_es: DP-SGD añade ruido a gradientes. Garantiza que inclusión/exclusión de un punto de datos no afecta significativamente la probabilidad de salida.
explanation_en: DP-SGD adds noise to gradients. Ensures that inclusion/exclusion of one data point doesn't significantly affect output probability.
source: Dwork, 'Differential Privacy: A Survey of Results' (2008); Abadi et al., 'Deep Learning with Differential Privacy' (2016)

question_es: El proceso de entrenar modelos de lenguaje para comportarse de acuerdo con valores humanos, preferencias y directrices de seguridad se llama ___ del modelo.
question_en: The process of training language models to behave according to human values, preferences, and safety guidelines is called model ___.
explanation_es: Técnicas: RLHF (feedback humano), Constitutional AI, instructions following. Objetivo: modelos seguros, útiles y honestos.
explanation_en: Techniques: RLHF (human feedback), Constitutional AI, instruction following. Goal: safe, helpful, and honest models.
source: Bai et al., 'Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback' (2022); Christiano et al., 'Deep RL from Human Preferences' (2017)

question_es: Las entradas cuidadosamente diseñadas creadas con la intención de engañar a un modelo de IA para producir predicciones incorrectas se llaman ejemplos ___.
question_en: Carefully designed inputs created with the intent to fool an AI model into producing incorrect predictions are known as ___ examples.
explanation_es: Ataques: FGSM, PGD, C&W. Defensas: adversarial training, certificación robusta. Relevante para seguridad de modelos en producción.
explanation_en: Attacks: FGSM, PGD, C&W. Defenses: adversarial training, certified robustness. Relevant for model security in production.
source: Ilyas et al., 'Adversarial Examples Are Not Bugs, They Are Features' (2019); Goodfellow et al., 'Explaining and Harnessing' (2014)

question_es: La métrica ___ mide la superposición de n-gramas entre texto generado automáticamente y texto de referencia humana usando precisión y recall.
question_en: The ____ score measures the n-gram overlap between automatically generated text and human reference text using precision and recall.
explanation_es: ROUGE-1/2/L. Popular en resumen automático. Limitaciones: no captura semántica, sensible a parafraseo. Complementar con BERTScore.
explanation_en: ROUGE-1/2/L. Popular in summarization. Limitations: doesn't capture semantics, sensitive to paraphrasing. Complement with BERTScore.
source: Lin, 'ROUGE: A Package for Automatic Evaluation of Summaries' (ACL 2004)

question_es: La métrica ___ evalúa la calidad de texto generado comparando tokens con referencias usando embeddings contextuales preentrenados en lugar de n-gramas.
question_en: The ____ metric evaluates text generation quality by comparing generated tokens with reference text using pre-trained contextual embeddings instead of n-grams.
explanation_es: Usa embeddings de BERT para capturar similitud semántica. Correlaciona mejor con evaluaciones humanas que BLEU/ROUGE.
explanation_en: Uses BERT embeddings to capture semantic similarity. Correlates better with human evaluation than BLEU/ROUGE.
source: Zhang et al., 'BERTScore: Evaluating Text Generation with BERT' (ICLR 2020)

question_es: Cuando un modelo de lenguaje genera información factualmente falsa, engañosa o fabricada presentada con confianza, este comportamiento se llama ___.
question_en: When a language model generates factually false, misleading, or fabricated information presented with confidence, this behavior is called ___.
explanation_es: Causas: entrenamiento en web ruidosa, falta de acceso a hechos actuales, softmax sin restricciones. Mitigación: RAG, fact-checking, guardrails.
explanation_en: Causes: noisy web training, lack of current facts, unconstrained softmax. Mitigation: RAG, fact-checking, guardrails.
source: Bender et al., 'On the Dangers of Stochastic Parrots' (FAccT 2021); Li et al., 'Hallucination Detection' (2023)

question_es: El enfoque metodológico donde un modelo de lenguaje evalúa la calidad del texto generado por otro modelo o sistema se llama evaluación ___.
question_en: The evaluation methodology where a language model assesses the quality of text generated by another model or system is called ___ evaluation.
explanation_es: LLM-as-judge es escalable y correlaciona bien con preferencias humanas. Prompts estructurados y calibración de modelos juez mejoran confiabilidad.
explanation_en: LLM-as-judge is scalable and correlates well with human preference. Structured prompts and judge calibration improve reliability.
source: Zhong et al., 'LLMs as Factuality Judges' (2023); Liang et al., 'Holistic Evaluation of Language Models' (2023)

question_es: La recolección y análisis sistemáticos de logs, métricas y trazas de sistemas de IA desplegados para entender comportamiento y diagnosticar problemas se llama ___.
question_en: The systematic collection and analysis of logs, metrics, and traces from deployed AI systems to understand behavior and diagnose problems is called ___.
explanation_es: Las 3 pilares: logs (eventos detallados), métricas (agregados), trazas (flujos). Herramientas: Arize, W&B, Datadog para LLMs.
explanation_en: Three pillars: logs (detailed events), metrics (aggregates), traces (flows). Tools: Arize, W&B, Datadog for LLMs.
source: Arize, Weights & Biases, MLflow documentation; distributed systems observability principles
